INSERT INTO weekly_ratings_delivery AS ledger (report_key, owner, state, payload)
VALUES ($1, $2, 'sending', $3::jsonb)
ON CONFLICT (report_key) DO UPDATE
SET owner = EXCLUDED.owner, state = 'sending', payload = EXCLUDED.payload,
    slack_ts = NULL, detail = NULL, updated_at = now()
WHERE ledger.state = 'failed'
RETURNING report_key, owner, state;

UPDATE weekly_ratings_delivery
SET state = $3, slack_ts = $4, detail = $5, updated_at = now()
WHERE report_key = $1 AND owner = $2 AND state = 'sending'
RETURNING report_key, state, slack_ts;
